thread.title: Apple and Samsung Settle After Fighting Seven Years in Court

author: BLOOMBERG NEWS
title: Apple and Samsung Settle After Fighting Seven Years in Court

organizations.name: samsung settle after fighting seven years in court apple

text:
Apple ( AAPL ) and Samsung Electronics have reached a settlement in their U.S. patent battle, putting an end to a seven-year fight over smartphone designs.
X The string of lawsuits between Apple and Samsung started in 2011. That's when Apple sued Samsung for allegedly copying the design of the iPhone in the creation of its own line of smartphones.
Terms of the accord weren't immediately disclosed. The settlement follows a damages retrial in which Apple won a $539 million jury award in May.
No Comments In a separate, previous publicized settlement over patents with HTC, Apple also didn't disclose settlement terms. Apple and Samsung didn't immediately respond to requests for comment.
 In 2012, a jury awarded Apple more than $1 billion in its initial showdown with South Korean rival Samsung in federal court in San Jose, Calif.
That verdict triggered multiple appeals all the way to the U.S. Supreme Court. The companies also faced off in a separate trial in the same court over different patent-infringement claims.
Apple shares were up fractionally near 185 .
